name: What is the process for replacing my old windows with sound insulating ones?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for replacing my old windows with sound insulating ones?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process typically begins with an initial consultation where we assess your current windows, discuss your noise concerns, and help you select the best sound insulating window options for your needs and budget. Next, we take precise measurements for custom fabrication. Once your new windows are ready, our certified installers will carefully remove your old windows, prepare the openings, and install the new sound insulating units, ensuring a tight seal. Finally, we conduct a thorough clean-up and a final walkthrough to ensure your complete satisfaction with the installation and performance.
acceptedAnswer.description: The replacement process includes consultation, precise measurements, custom fabrication, professional installation of new windows, and a final walkthrough to ensure satisfaction.
